source: I WANT A DRIVING GAME BUT! LOW GRAPHICS SO PEOPLE WITH POOR DEVICE CAN PLAY THE GAME ALSO YOU CAN DRIVE ANY CARS,JEEPS,MOTOR CYCLES AND MANY MORE THAT YOU CAN DRIVE.AND THE VEHICLES CAN ALSO CRUSH THAT RELATE TO MANY INCIDENTS ON REAL LIFE ALSO WHEN YOU CRUSHES THAT YOU INSTANTLY DIE ALSO COMES WITH LITTLE ANIMATION WHEN YOU DIE OF CAR CRUSHES.AND DIFFERENT ANIMATION WHEN YOU CRUSH INTO A POLE OR A TRAFFIC LIGHTS OR INTO A WALL.AND MAKE THE MAP BIG SO PEOPLE CAN EXPLORE THE MAP ALSO MAKE A BUILDINGS TEXTURE ABLE SO PEOPLE AROUND THE WORLD ENJOY ABLE SO OUR GAME CAN REACH INTO TOP 15 OF THE ROBLOX GAMES

image_prompt.text: Wide vehicle roads running through the whole map, with intersections, so cars, jeeps, and motorcycles can drive anywhere
A large common open area the whole server shares, held here as free-roam ground rather than an extraction field
Poles, traffic lights, and walls placed along the streets as the things you crash into, with the collision reaction being the entertainment
Simple low-poly buildings with flat swappable textures, clustered so there is somewhere to explore

layout_placement.text: A big open map with room to drive well beyond the built-up streets

notes: Simulation rather than Racing: the prompt has no lap, no finish, and no competitor - it is free driving and exploration, which the Racing boundary note routes to Vehicle Sim.
Low-graphics-for-weak-devices is a build-wide constraint on poly and texture budget with no field to carry it.
'Make a buildings texture able' is ambiguous - it may mean textured buildings, or buildings players can retexture. Read as the former; flagged.
The preset's shared resource field has no function here - kept and labelled rather than dropped.

open_questions.ask: How big is big - a few city blocks, or a drive-for-minutes open world? It changes what runs on a weak device.
Did you mean buildings that simply have textures, or buildings players can apply their own textures to?

theme: Modern Urban, deliberately low-poly and low-texture: simple blocky buildings, plain asphalt, flat colours over detail

coverage_missing.ask: How large should the map be?
City only, or city plus countryside and highway?
Is there anything to do besides drive and crash - deliveries, races, checkpoints?
Do the vehicles spawn from a garage or a menu, and is there anywhere they live on the map?

answers.ask: How big is big - a few city blocks, or a drive-for-minutes open world? It changes what runs on a weak device.
answers.answer: Make it a few city blocks with roads and areas to explore, optimized for weak devices rather than a drive-for-minutes open world.

answers.ask: Did you mean buildings that simply have textures, or buildings players can apply their own textures to?
answers.answer: I mean buildings should simply have textures; players do not need to apply their own textures.
